events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Issy-les-Moulineaux near Paris.

evidence.quote: Zink was born in Issy-les-Moulineaux near Paris

events.text: Graduated from the Ecole normale superieure.

evidence.quote: He graduated from the École normale supérieure in 1968

events.text: Completed doctoral thesis Recherches sur les pastourelles medievales.

evidence.quote: completed his doctoral thesis , Recherches sur les pastourelles médiévales , in 1970

events.text: Completed second thesis La Predication en langue romane avant 1300.

evidence.quote: completed a second thesis , La Prédication en langue romane avant 1300 in 1975

events.text: Became full professor at the University of Toulouse-Le Mirail.

evidence.quote: the following year became a full professor at the University of Toulouse-Le Mirail

events.text: Published La Predication en langue romane avant 1300 (Champion); revised 1982.
Published Belle: essai sur les chansons de toile (Champion).
Published Roman rose et rose rouge (Nizet).
Published edition and translation of Le Roman d'Apollonius de Tyr.
Published La Subjectivite litteraire autour du siecle de saint Louis (PUF).
Returned to the Sorbonne as a professor.

evidence.quote: returned to the Sorbonne in 1987 as a professor

events.text: Published Rutebeuf, Oeuvres completes, 2 vols (1989-1990, Garnier).
Published Le Moyen Age: litterature francaise (Presses Universitaires de Nancy).
Published commentary on Girart de Roussillon, with M. Thomas.
Published Les Voix de la conscience (Paradigme), a collection of articles.
Published Litterature francaise au Moyen Age (PUF).
Published Histoire europeenne du roman medieval, with M. Stanesco.
Published revised edition of Dictionnaire des lettres francaises, Le Moyen Age, with G. Hasenohr; reprinted 1994.
Moved to the College de France.

evidence.quote: moved to the Collège de France in 1994

events.text: Became chair of Literatures of Medieval France at the College de France.

evidence.quote: moved to the Collège de France in 1994 , where he became the chair of Literatures of Medieval France

events.text: Published Le Moyen Age et ses chansons ou Un passe en trompe-l'oeil.
Published L'Art d'aimer au Moyen Age, with co-authors.
Published novel Le Tiers d'amour: un roman des troubadours.
Published Froissart et le temps (PUF).
Published Le Jongleur de Notre-Dame: contes chretiens du Moyen Age (Seuil).
Published Pages manuscrites de la litterature medievale, with G. Hasenohr.
Elected to the Academie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres.

evidence.quote: He was elected to the Académie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres in 2000

events.text: Edited L'Oeuvre et son ombre, with contributions by other authors.
Published novel Deodat ou La transparence: un roman du Graal (Seuil).
Published Poesie et conversion au Moyen Age (PUF).
Named chair of the board of directors of the Ecole normale superieure.

evidence.quote: He was named chair of the board of directors of the École normale supérieure in 2004

events.text: Published Le Moyen Age de Gaston Paris (Odile Jacob).
Published Le Moyen Age a la lettre: abecedaire medieval (Tallandier).
Published novel Arsene Lupin et le mystere d'Arsonval (Fallois).
Edited Le Moyen Age de Gaston Paris: la poesie a l'epreuve de la philologie.
Resigned his seat on the ENS board in protest of Monique Canto-Sperber becoming head.

evidence.quote: resigning his seat the following year in protest of Monique Canto-Sperber becoming the head of the institution

events.text: Published Naissance, Renaissances, Moyen Age - XVIe siecle, with F. Lestringant.
Edited Froissart dans sa forge, colloquium proceedings (Boccard).

events.label: award
events.text: Received a Balzan Prize.

evidence.quote: He received a Balzan Prize in 2007

events.text: Published novel Un portefeuille toulousain (Fallois).
Published memoir Seuls les enfants savent lire (reissued 2019, Belles Lettres).
Published Moyen Age et Renaissance au College de France, with P. Toubert.
Published Livres anciens, lecture vivante (Odile Jacob).
Became Permanent Secretary of the Academie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres.

evidence.quote: a title he has held since 2011

events.text: Published D'autres langues que la mienne (Odile Jacob).
Published Bienvenue au Moyen Age (Equateurs / France Inter).
Left the College de France, ending chair of Literatures of Medieval France.

evidence.quote: Zink left the Collège de France in 2016

events.text: Elected to seat 37 of the Academie francaise.

evidence.quote: was elected to the Académie française in 2017
In 2017 , Zink was elected to seat 37 of the Académie française

events.text: Published L'Humiliation, le Moyen Age et nous (Albin Michel).
Published novel Berets noirs, berets rouges (Fallois).
